title: Mixing: Children Children by Wings | 1978
content:
Studio Two, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Geoff Emerick

‘Children Children’ was mixed in stereo for Wings’ sixth studio album London Town on 10 January 1978.

Following this session, the only songs on the album still requiring mixes were ‘Girlfriend’, ‘I’ve Had Enough’, ‘With A Little Luck’, ‘Famous Groupies’, ‘Deliver Your Children’, ‘Don’t Let It Bring You Down’, and ‘Morse Moose And The Grey Goose’.
